title: Holiday Paint & Pint
summary: Whether you’re a seasoned painter or not, this event is perfect for anyone looking to unwind this holiday season and create a festive painting. A great idea for gift giving or to add some holiday cheer to your home! Ticket includes all materials, 2-hour guided painting instruction and one ticket for your choice of pint. Don’t miss out on this unique experience – limited spots available – reserve your spot now!
